hero.title: A cybersecurity academy born in Angola, with global ambition.
hero.subtitle: We combine education, practice and career development to train the next generation of cybersecurity professionals in Africa.

who.title: Who we are
who.description: Nobyte Academy is an Angolan organization dedicated to developing cybersecurity talent through practical training, mentorship, labs, awareness programs and community events. We don't just sell courses: we guide people through a complete journey, from beginner to professional.

mission.title: Mission
mission.description: To create accessible cybersecurity education through practical training, mentorship and awareness programs, preparing people and organizations for the digital challenges of the future.

vision.title: Vision
vision.description: To become a reference organization for cybersecurity education in Angola and Africa, contributing to the development of professionals and a safer digital ecosystem.

approach.title: Our approach
approach.description: We combine four pillars in everything we do:

pillars.title: Education
pillars.description: Current, clear, applicable technical content — from zero to advanced.

pillars.title: Practice
pillars.description: Labs, projects and real simulations instead of theory in isolation.

pillars.title: Career
pillars.description: Mentorship, CV, portfolio and preparation for real market interviews.

pillars.title: Community
pillars.description: Events, networking and a living network of professionals and organizations.

hero.title: A path for every profile, from first contact to specialization.
hero.subtitle: Four complementary programs covering career, technical training, awareness, and corporate and academic workshops.

list.title: Cybersecurity Fundamentals
list.description: An entry point to understand threats, risks, networks, systems and the principles of digital protection.

list.title: Ethical Hacking Essentials
list.description: A practical introduction to offensive security through controlled labs and a strong focus on ethics, methodology and reporting.

list.title: SOC Analyst Fundamentals
list.description: An introduction to monitoring, log analysis, detection and incident response in a SOC environment.

list.title: WAF & SIEM Fundamentals
list.description: Understand how WAF and SIEM help teams observe, detect and reduce risk in modern environments.

cta.title: Not sure where to start?
cta.description: Our team can help identify the right path for your current level and career goal.

paths.title: Pentester

paths.title: Application Security Engineer

paths.title: Cloud Security Engineer
paths.description: Protecting infrastructure and workloads across modern cloud environments.

paths.title: Security Analyst
paths.description: Ongoing risk assessment and implementation of security controls across the organization.

hero.title: Nobyte Security Day
hero.subtitle: Nobyte Academy's official cybersecurity awareness and education program, bringing together professionals, students, companies and the community across Angola.

what.title: What is Security Day?
what.description: A monthly initiative that promotes cybersecurity awareness, education and culture through talks, live demonstrations and networking — building an active learning community focused on digital fraud prevention.
what.cadence: Held monthly, preferably on the first Saturday of each month, running about 3 hours.

items.title: Digital Fraud & Social Engineering
items.description: Phishing, banking scams, WhatsApp and QR-code fraud, with a live fraud-detection demonstration.

items.title: Digital Safety for Families
items.description: Cyberbullying, social media and child protection, with a privacy-settings workshop.

items.title: Cybersecurity Careers
items.description: Career paths, certifications and employability roadmaps, with a panel of guest professionals.

items.title: Enterprise Security
items.description: Ransomware, security culture and risk management, with an incident simulation and roundtable.

evolution.title: On the road to the Nobyte Cyber Summit
evolution.description: Security Day is the foundation for the future annual 'Nobyte Cyber Summit', bringing together national and international experts, companies, universities and the cybersecurity community.

registration.title: Reserve your spot
registration.description: Registration is free and limited per edition. Leave your details and receive the invitation for the next session.
